title: 第30章 卧薪尝胆，受惊的马车
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
高达八十多点的悟性，让陆林第一时间就理解了青松锻骨法的修炼方法。

    原来。

    武者在凝练出真血之后，才能修炼内功的秘密，就在于一点。

    血多而气少。

    初期修炼内力，不会积攒太多，食之无味，弃之可惜。

    修炼时间越长，内力积攒的越多，实力就会更强。

    短期无用，长期却必然有用。

    于是，聪明的武者前辈，就想出了让内力和真血组合的办法。

    在下三品修炼时，以血来带气，增强实力。

    当内力足够强大，则可以单独以内力对敌了。

    回到正题。

    锻骨的过程，其本质就是用内力来淬炼骨骼。

    陆林之前的思路是对的，但是方法不对。

    内力于体内诞生，天然亲近自身。

    以内力去淬炼骨骼，那第一时间就会被骨骼吸收。

    这般操作本没有错，但想要完成淬骨，恐怕少则二十年，多则五六十年都有可能。

    青松锻骨法，给陆林提供了一个全新的思路。

    从外到内，从表及里。

    辅以青松桩功，气血绵绵不絶，可以全天候无休息的淬炼骨骼。

    “牛三哥，这锻骨法需要咱们先修炼出内力，形成气血后才能修炼。”

    “啊？你这么快就看会了？”

    牛三惊讶不已，困扰了他一晚上的难题，陆林只是几个呼吸就解决了。

    这小伙子的悟性这么高吗？

    “我也就是看了个大概而已，到时候牛三哥修炼起来，有任何问题再跟我说。”

    “哈哈哈，陆林你果然是个天才，任大人没看错，你的到来，对我们缉盗班来说，那就是如虎添翼啊，恰好时候不早了，我请你简单吃点。”

    “啊？牛三哥，不用了，要不还是我来请你。”

    “可别，我是大哥，你是小兄弟，哪有让小兄弟请大哥的，走走走，以后咱们兄弟别这么客气了。”

    牛三和褚二都是热心肠的人，陆林推脱不过，只能跟上。

    牛三带他来的，还是上次那家小店。

    这地方都快成白杨镇三班捕快，固定的食堂了。

    两人正吃着，一道身影走了进来。

    “小二，给我来两壶酒，再来一盘熟黄豆。”

    “任大人？！”

    牛三一眼就看出是任忠武，“大人这是刚从县里回来，肯定累坏了，今日正好陆林也在，我们一起为任大人接风洗尘。”

    任忠武一副被人抽走了精气神的模样，有气无力。

    他对陆林点点头，随后重重坐在条凳上。

    “任大人，平时不是很少饮酒吗，怎么今日……”

    牛三还想多问几句，陆林赶忙一扯他的袖子。

    “牛三哥，任大人应该是累了，让他先吃些酒菜吧。”

    “哦，对，对，任大人，先吃点东西。”

    牛三这才意识到不对。

    他跟陆林挤眉弄眼，想要问这是什么情况。

    陆林上哪知道去。

    他算上这一次，才是第三次跟任忠武见面。

    任忠武也不吃菜，就着自己点的熟黄豆，一个劲的喝酒。

    不一会，两壶酒就给他干光。

    “小二，再来一壶酒。”
content_en:
With a comprehension level of more than 80 points, Lu Lin immediately understood the Qingsong Bone Forging Method.

turn out to be.

The secret that a warrior can practice his inner strength after condensing his true blood lies in one point.

There is more blood and less Qi.

In the early stages of cultivating internal strength, you won't accumulate much, it will be tasteless if you eat it, and it would be a pity to throw it away.

The longer you practice, the more internal energy you accumulate, and the stronger you will be.

It is useless in the short term, but it will be useful in the long term.

Therefore, the smart senior warrior came up with a way to combine inner strength and true blood.

When practicing at the lower third level, blood is used to bring Qi and enhance strength.

When the internal force is strong enough, you can fight the enemy with your internal force alone.

Back to topic.

The essence of the process of bone forging is to use internal force to temper the bones.

Lu Lin's idea before was right, but his method was wrong.

Internal force is born in the body and is naturally close to oneself.

If you use internal force to temper the bones, they will be absorbed by the bones immediately.

There is nothing wrong with this operation, but to complete bone tempering, it may take as little as twenty years and as many as fifty or sixty years.

The green pine bone forging method provided Lu Lin with a brand new idea.

From the outside to the inside, from the outside to the inside.

Supplemented by Qingsong Zhuang Gong, Qi and blood are endless, and bones can be tempered around the clock without rest.

"Brother Niu San, this bone forging method requires us to cultivate our internal strength first and form qi and blood before we can practice it."

"Huh? You can see it so soon?"

Niu San was surprised. The problem that had troubled him all night was solved by Lu Lin in just a few breaths.

Is this young man so savvy?

"I just took a rough look. When Brother Niu San starts practicing, please tell me if you have any questions."

"Hahaha, Lu Lin, you are indeed a genius. Master Ren is right. Your arrival will be even more powerful for our anti-theft team. It happens to be getting late, so I'll treat you to something simple."

"Ah? Brother Niu San, no need, or I'll treat you."

"No, I am the eldest brother and you are the little brother. How can the little brother invite the eldest brother? Let's go, let's not be so polite in the future."

Niu San and Chu Er were both warm-hearted people, so Lu Lin couldn't shirk them and had to follow them.

Niu San brought him to the same small shop as last time.

This place has almost become a regular canteen for the three policemen in Baiyang Town.

While the two were eating, a figure walked in.

"Waiter, bring me two bottles of wine and a plate of cooked soybeans."

"Lord Ren?!"

Niu San could tell it was Ren Zhongwu at a glance, "Your Excellency, you have just come back from the county. You must be exhausted. Lu Lin happens to be here today. Let's take care of Mr. Ren."

Ren Zhongwu looked as if his energy had been drained away, and he was weak.

He nodded to Lu Lin and then sat down heavily on the bench.

"Sir Ren, don't you rarely drink alcohol? Why today..."

Niu San wanted to ask a few more questions, but Lu Lin hurriedly pulled his sleeve.

"Brother Niu San, Master Ren must be tired. Let him have some food and wine first."

"Oh, yes, yes, Master Ren, eat something first."

Only then did Niu San realize something was wrong.

He winked at Lu Lin and wanted to ask what was going on.

Where does Lu Linshang know where to go?

Counting this time, this was his third meeting with Ren Zhongwu.

Ren Zhongwu didn't eat vegetables either, so he just drank the cooked soybeans he ordered and kept drinking.

After a while, he drained the two jugs of wine.

"Waiter, another bottle of wine."
